name: Huntsman
description: The cave's second arrival: flat, wide and nothing but reach. Laterigrade legs leave the body sideways rather than fore-and-aft, so this is the one body here that is wider across than it is long, and the one the game rotates instead of mirroring — drawn along +x with no up to preserve, the way the Courser and the Scolopend are. Dark carapace with pale tips, so what is read at speed is eight bright points closing. It has never spun a line: there is no silk anywhere on this drawing, which is the whole of what tells it from the Orbweaver in silhouette. Gameplay radius 40.

enraged.description: Half down: the carapace splits along every seam and what is under it is lit — dark body to bone, and the leg tips go to ember.

run.description: eight long legs in two alternating fours at the fastest cadence any body this size has here; the abdomen barely moves, because on a laterigrade spider the legs do all of it

coil.description: the windup, played once and held: every leg swings square-on and folds at the knee, the body draws back over its own centre, the fangs come forward. It is the same gather parameter the release reads backwards, so the two meet exactly

strike.description: the release, opening on exactly the frame the windup ended on: the folded legs throw open past their rest pose and the body goes out over them
